description: Returns a principal's effective OneLake access as expanded table entries, including row-level and column-level constraints.
notes: The response ETag represents the computed effective-access state. Pass it verbatim, including quotes, with --if-match or --if-none-match. Without --expand-tables, Table entries may group row and column constraints by tablePath. Folder entries have no table constraints.

query_examples.description: Inspect expanded table paths and row constraints.
